from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
import draccus
from marin.execution.lazy import materialized_config
from marin.training.training import apply_output_path
from experiments.ema_gram.train import build_training_step, run_training
from experiments.ema_gram.plan import Cell
p = Path("logbooks/20-ema-gram-polar/loss-pair-prepared.json")
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "992bd1f9f6632229b73ed114de6ac5d0cdef468405d89898afebcb162cd366ac"
prepared = json.loads(p.read_text())
for name, expected in prepared["source_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
step = build_training_step(Cell(0.25, 1e-4, 0.002, seed=0), "2026.11.03.21", tpu_type="v4-32", host_memory="256g", eigh_layout="replicated", eigh_implementation="default", initialize_from=prepared["checkpoint"], profile_start_step=940, profile_steps=1)
pod = materialized_config(step, "gs://marin-us-central2")
pod = replace(pod, train_config=apply_output_path(pod.train_config, pod.output_path))
assert draccus.encode(pod) == prepared["configs"]["replicated"]
run_training(pod)
'
